context: Two teens debrief a long-awaited movie
purpose: Teach: ひとつひとつ/案の定/暫く/流石/ずーっと/飼っ/つづける/掛かる

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねぇ昨日の映画、ずーっと前から楽しみにしてたやつ、ついに観れたね！
lines.en: Hey, that movie we'd been looking forward to forever, we finally got to see it!
lines.style: Excited teen girl, bubbly and animated, voice rising with enthusiasm, casual schoolgirl tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、案の定めっちゃ泣いたわ。主人公が犬を飼ってるシーン、あれヤバくない？
lines.en: Yeah, as expected I cried a ton. That scene where the main character has a dog, wasn't that intense?
lines.style: Teen boy speaking casually, slightly hoarse, animated but trying to play it cool

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかる！しかも演出がひとつひとつ丁寧でさ、流石あの監督って感じだった。
lines.en: Right! And every single bit of the direction was so careful, you could really tell it was that director.
lines.style: Enthusiastic teen girl, fast-paced, gesturing while talking, voice full of admiration

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: な。エンディングまで暫く沈黙してたもん、俺。感情の整理に時間掛かるタイプの映画。
lines.en: Yeah. I stayed silent for a while after the ending. It's the kind of movie that takes time to process emotionally.
lines.style: Reflective teen boy, softer tone, slower pace, slightly drained from emotion

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あの兄弟が最後まで信じつづけるとこ、もう号泣ポイントだったよ。
lines.en: That part where the brothers keep believing till the very end, total ugly-cry moment.
lines.style: Teen girl voice wavering with emotion, slightly choked up, animated hand gestures

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 続編あるらしいよ。来年公開だって。
lines.en: Apparently there's a sequel. They're saying it comes out next year.
lines.style: Teen boy with rising curiosity, slight smirk in voice, leaning forward conversationally

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えーマジ！？また一年ずーっと待つの辛いんだけど！
lines.en: What, seriously?! Having to wait another whole year is gonna be torture!
lines.style: Teen girl exaggerated shock, voice cracking with mock despair, very expressive

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 待つしかないっしょ。とりあえず今夜もう一回観ようぜ。
lines.en: Nothing to do but wait. For now let's just watch it one more time tonight.
lines.style: Teen boy casual and resolved, easy laugh in voice, suggesting plans naturally
